1.t: When the Inevitable Event takes place

2.t: then no one can deny it has come

4.t: When the earth will be violently shaken

5.t: and the mountains will be crushed to pieces

7.t: you will ˹all˺ be ˹divided into˺ three groups

8.t: the people of the right, how ˹blessed˺ will they be

9.t: the people of the left, how ˹miserable˺ will they be

10.t: and the foremost ˹in faith˺ will be the foremost ˹in Paradise˺

11.t: They are the ones nearest ˹to Allah˺

13.t: ˹They will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations

14.t: and a few from later generations

17.t: They will be waited on by eternal youths

18.t: with cups, pitchers, and a drink ˹of pure wine˺ from a flowing stream

19.t: that will cause them neither headache nor intoxication

20.t: ˹They will also be served˺ any fruit they choose

21.t: and meat from any bird they desire

22.t: And ˹they will have˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes

24.t: ˹all˺ as a reward for what they used to do

25.t: There they will never hear any idle or sinful talk—
25.tr: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwanw Wa-laa taaseemaa

27.t: And the people of the right—how ˹blessed˺ will they be

28.t: ˹They will be˺ amid thornless lote trees

33.t: never out of season nor forbidden—

35.t: Indeed, We will have perfectly created their mates

38.t: for the people of the right

39.t: ˹who will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations

40.t: and a multitude from later generations

41.t: And the people of the left—how ˹miserable˺ will they be

42.t: ˹They will be˺ in scorching heat and boiling water

43.t: in the shade of black smoke

45.t: Indeed, before this ˹torment˺ they were spoiled by luxury

46.t: and persisted in the worst of sin

47.t: They used to ask ˹mockingly˺, “When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected
47.tr: Wa-kaanoo yaqooloona a'izaa mitnaa Wa-kunnaa turaabanw Wa-izaaman 'ainnaa lamab'oosoon

49.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Most certainly, earlier and later generations

50.t: will surely be gathered ˹together˺ for the appointed Day

52.t: will certainly eat from ˹the fruit of˺ the trees of Zaqqûm

54.t: Then on top of that you will drink boiling water—

55.t: and you will drink ˹it˺ like thirsty camels do.”

56.t: This will be their accommodation on the Day of Judgment

57.t: It is We Who created you. Will you not then believe ˹in resurrection˺

58.t: Have you considered what you ejaculate

59.t: Is it you who create ˹a child out of˺ it, or is it We Who do so

60.t: We have ordained death for ˹all of˺ you, and We cannot be prevented
60.tr: Nahnu qaddarnaa baina-kumul mawta Wa-maa nahnu bimasbooqeen

61.t: from transforming and recreating you in forms unknown to you
61.tr: Alaaa an nubaddila amsaalakum Wa-nunshi'akum fee maa laa ta'lamoon

62.t: You already know how you were first created. Will you not then be mindful

63.t: Have you considered what you sow

64.t: Is it you who cause it to grow, or is it We Who do so

65.t: If We willed, We could simply reduce this ˹harvest˺ to chaff, leaving you to lament
65.tr: Law nashaaa'u laja'al-naahu hutaaman fazaltum tafakkahoon

67.t: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

68.t: Have you considered the water you drink

69.t: Is it you who bring it down from the clouds, or is it We Who do so
69.tr: A-antum anzaltumoohu minal muzni am nahnul munziloon

70.t: If We willed, We could make it salty. Will you not then give thanks
70.tr: Law nashaaa'u ja'alnaahu ujaajan falaw-laa tashkuroon

71.t: Have you considered the fire you kindle

72.t: Is it you who produce its trees, or is it We Who do so
72.tr: A-antum anshaatum shajaratahaaa am nahnul munshi'oon

73.t: We have made it ˹as˺ a reminder ˹of the Hellfire˺ and a provision for the travellers

74.t: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest

75.t: So I do swear by the positions of the stars—

76.t: and this, if only you knew, is indeed a great oath—

77.t: that this is truly a noble Quran

79.t: touched by none except the purified ˹angels˺

80.t: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds

81.t: How can you then take this message lightly

82.t: and repay ˹Allah for˺ your provisions with denial

83.t: Why then ˹are you helpless˺ when the soul ˹of a dying person˺ reaches ˹their˺ throat

85.t: And We are nearer to such a person than you, but you cannot see
85.tr: Wa-nahnu aqrabu ilaihi minkum Wa-laakil laa tubsiroon

86.t: Now, if you are not subject to Our Will ˹as you claim˺

87.t: bring that soul back, if what you say is true

88.t: So, if the deceased is one of those brought near ˹to Us˺

89.t: then ˹such a person will have˺ serenity, fragrance, and a Garden of Bliss

90.t: And if the deceased is one of the people of the right
90.tr: Wa-ammaaa in kaana min as-haabil yameen

91.t: then ˹they will be told,˺ “Greetings to you from the people of the right.”

92.t: But if such person is one of the misguided deniers
92.tr: Wa-ammaaa in kaana minal mukazzibeenad daaalleen

93.t: then their accommodation will be boiling water ˹to drink˺

95.t: Indeed, this is the absolute truth

96.t: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
